why.的: 的 links a describing word to a noun; it does not ask a yes/no question.
why.了: 了 marks a finished action or a new situation; it does not turn a statement into a question.

note: Add 吗 to the end of a statement to ask yes or no.

why.吗: 吗 comes at the end of a yes/no question, not between 我 and 书.
why.了: 了 marks a finished action or a new situation; it cannot link 我 and 书.

note: 的 joins 我 (the owner) to 书 (the thing).

why.吗: 吗 goes at the end of a question, not after a verb in the middle of a sentence.
